events.name: DENY

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for std-cache-aside / CacheEntryOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

evictionPolicy.description: How entries are evicted when the cache fills: least-recently-used, least-frequently-used, first-in-first-out, or TTL-only (never evict early).

maxCacheSize.description: Hard cap on cached entries before eviction. 0 = unlimited.

staleWhileRevalidate.description: When true, serve stale entries to consumers while a background refresh fetches fresh data. Reduces latency at the cost of brief staleness.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Agenda group-by field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field the agenda list groups its day sections by. Rebound hosts point this at their own timestamp column (e.g. startTime, scheduledAt).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: group field, section field, day field

fields.name: syncToken
fields.description: Scratch: Google incremental-sync token from the last listEvents; in-memory per instance — a restart falls back to a full list.

fields.name: lastSyncedAt
fields.description: When the last full push+pull cycle completed; 0 = never.

fields.name: headId
fields.description: Scratch: id of the target row the push loop is currently exporting.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: Scratch: remote events remaining in the current pull-upsert loop.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Last sync failure detail; blank = none.

events.name: CAL_SYNCED
events.description: A full push+pull cycle completed; wire to std-notify-on-event or a status surface.

events.name: CAL_SYNC_FAILED
events.description: A calendar service call / fetch / persist failed — lastError carries the detail and the cycle stops until the next trigger.

events.name: PUSH_ROWS_LOADED
events.description: Target rows with a blank externalEventId marker — the remaining local→remote export queue.

events.name: CAL_EVENT_CREATED
events.description: calendar.createEvent result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor.

events.name: PUSH_STEPPED
events.description: Target row stamped with its new externalEventId; drives the next push pass.

events.name: CAL_REMOTE_LISTED
events.description: calendar.listEvents result — the remote change set for the pull-upsert loop.

events.name: PULL_TARGET_LOADED
events.description: CalendarEvent rows loaded for externalEventId matching in the pull-upsert.

events.name: PULL_STEPPED
events.description: One remote event upserted into the CalendarEvent store; drives the next pull pass.

events.name: PULL_NEXT
events.description: Pull loop control: how many remote events remain in the queue.

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: end date field, finishes field

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: place field, venue field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Start field

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: start date field, begins field, scheduledAt field

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: entity to sync, source entity, record type, appointments entity, sessions entity

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: summary field, name field

events.name: ITEMS_LOADED
events.description: Data has been retrieved and processed for display.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aggregation
overridableConfigKeys.description: How values within a bucket combine into one number
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'count' / 'how many' -> count; 'total' / 'sum of' -> sum; 'average' / 'mean' -> avg; 'minimum' / 'lowest' -> min; 'maximum' / 'highest' -> max

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group / categorize / bucket / split by field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field whose values become the chart's category buckets. Set this when the user voices 'group by X' / 'categorize by X' / 'bucket by X' / 'split by X' / 'break down by X' for any non-time field X (for time-units, set period + timeAxis=true instead).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / categorize / breakdown by / split by / segment by. user phrases: 'group by status' -> categoryField=status; 'group by region' / 'by region' -> categoryField=region; 'group by category' / 'by category' -> categoryField=category; 'group by product' / 'by product' -> categoryField=product; 'group by month' / 'by month' -> categoryField=month (when explicitly requested as a category, not a time bucket); 'split by X' / 'break down by X' / 'segment by X' / 'bucket by X' -> categoryField=X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Chart type
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual format for the rendered chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: bar = vertical bars, line = connected line, pie = pie chart, donut = pie with hole, area = filled area chart, histogram = frequency distribution, scatter = XY scatter. user phrases: 'switch to donut' / 'make it a donut' / 'as a donut chart' -> donut; 'use a pie chart' -> pie; 'show as line' / 'line chart' -> line; 'as bars' / 'bar chart' -> bar

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drill event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when a user clicks a chart point
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: click-through navigation event. user phrases: 'on click navigate to X' / 'drill into X' / 'when clicked open X' -> X event name

overridableConfigKeys.label: Chart height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pixel height of the rendered chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: vertical size in pixels. user phrases: 'taller' / 'make it taller' / 'increase height' / 'bigger vertically' -> larger number (e.g. 300, 400); 'shorter' / 'smaller' -> smaller; 'set height to 300' / '300px tall' -> 300

overridableConfigKeys.label: Top N
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keep only the first N points after sorting (0 = all)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'top 5' -> 5; 'top 10' -> 10; 'first 3' -> 3; 'all' / 'no limit' -> 0; 'show all' -> 0

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group by month / quarter / week / day / year
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group by month, quarter, week, day, or year — the calendar bucket the chart groups data into. Set ALONGSIDE timeAxis=true whenever the user says 'group by <time-unit>' or 'by <time-unit>' or 'rebucket to <time-unit>' or 'instead of <other-time-unit>'.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / change bucket / group differently. user phrases: 'group by month' / 'by month' / 'monthly' / 'monthly buckets' / 'switch to monthly' / 'instead of quarter' -> month; 'group by quarter' / 'by quarter' / 'quarterly' -> quarter; 'group by week' / 'by week' / 'weekly' / 'weekly buckets' -> week; 'group by day' / 'by day' / 'daily' / 'daily buckets' -> day; 'group by year' / 'by year' / 'yearly' / 'annually' -> year. Whenever the user voices 'group by <time-unit>' BOTH period AND timeAxis=true should be set.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Series
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pre-formatted multi-series spec for stacked or layered charts
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: multiple lines / bars per category. user phrases: 'compare X and Y' -> add two series entries

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show legend
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: true shows the color key. user phrases: 'show legend' / 'show the legend' / 'show key' / 'with legend' / 'with a legend' -> true; 'hide legend' / 'no legend' / 'without legend' / 'remove legend' -> false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show values
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render the numeric value on top of each data point
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'show values' / 'show numbers on bars' / 'with data labels' / 'label the bars' -> true; 'hide values' / 'no labels' -> false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort direction
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ascending or descending order for the sort field
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: asc = ascending = lowest-to-highest = low-to-high = smallest-first. desc = descending = highest-to-lowest = high-to-low = largest-first. user phrases: 'highest to lowest' / 'largest first' / 'descending' -> desc; 'lowest to highest' / 'smallest first' / 'ascending' -> asc

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort by
overridableConfigKeys.description: Order points by value, label, or leave unsorted
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'sort by value' / 'order by amount' -> value; 'sort alphabetically' / 'sort by name' -> label; 'no sort' / 'leave order' -> none

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stacking
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stack bars, normalize to 100%, or render side-by-side
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'side by side' / 'grouped' -> none; 'stacked' / 'stack the bars' -> stack; 'percent stacked' / '100% stacked' / 'normalized' -> normalize

overridableConfigKeys.label: Subtitle
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: secondary header below the title. user phrases: 'with subtitle X' / 'set subtitle to X' -> X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Time axis
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group by timeField bucketed by period instead of categoryField
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: true means group by date / month / time. user phrases: 'group by month / week / year / date' -> set timeAxis=true; 'group by status / category' -> timeAxis=false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Date field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field used as the time axis when timeAxis is on
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the date / timestamp / created-at column. set when timeAxis=true

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the chart's header text. user phrases: 'rename to X' / 'title it X' / 'change the title to X' / 'call it X' -> X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Numeric field aggregated per bucket (blank = row count)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the numeric column to aggregate. empty string counts rows. user phrases: 'sum revenue' -> valueField=revenue + aggregation=sum

overridableConfigKeys.label: Render pattern
overridableConfigKeys.description: UI pattern used to draw the chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: internal pattern selector. user prompts rarely target this directly — pattern selection is upstream

events.synonyms: tree update, insert result, traversal result, node count

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: INSERT_VALUE
events.description: Insert the next config-declared value: descends one comparison step per press from the root, coloring the descent cursor and comparison trail, until it attaches as a leaf. Pressing again while a descent is in flight continues that same descent.
events.synonyms: insert, add, next value, descend, attach

events.name: DELETE_VALUE
events.description: Undo the most recently inserted value — removes its node/edge/entry and rewinds the insert cursor by one so the same value can be re-inserted.

events.name: RUN_TRAVERSAL
events.description: Advance the traversal sweep one node at a time in the configured order (inorder/preorder/levelorder); pressing after the sweep completes starts a fresh sweep.
events.synonyms: traverse, sweep, visit, walk, in-order, pre-order, level-order

events.name: TOGGLE_RUN
events.description: Toggle auto-stepping: while running, the tick sweeps the traversal one node forward every step. Has no effect on Insert/Delete, which stay manual.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Clear the tree back to empty and restore the insert cursor and running flag from config, ready to insert from the first value again.

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: balance, height, balance readout

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show Comparisons

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: comparisons, narration detail

overridableConfigKeys.label: Traversal Kind

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: traversal, in-order, pre-order, level-order, sweep

overridableConfigKeys.label: Values
overridableConfigKeys.description: The values Insert feeds into the tree, one per descent, in order.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: keys, values to insert, dataset, sequence

fields.name: source
fields.description: ImportSource descriptor of the run (kind + options), supplied by the host.

fields.name: files
fields.description: Client-side file metadata for upload sources (name/size/type/lastModified).

fields.name: target
fields.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle position of the run.

fields.name: documents
fields.description: Document metadata listed from the source.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Most recently fetched document content.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: Staged/committed/failed/skipped counts.

fields.name: units
fields.description: Staged ImportUnits ready for review (ref/targetEntity/fields/parentRef), when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.synonyms: staged units, preview rows, import rows, staged rows

fields.name: skipped
fields.description: Source elements skipped during staging with a reason each, when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.synonyms: skipped rows, skipped elements, staging skips

fields.name: validationErrors
fields.description: Validation errors surfaced during staging, when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.synonyms: staging errors, validation issues, import errors

fields.name: error
fields.description: Failure detail when status is failed.

events.name: DOCUMENTS_LISTED
events.description: migration.listDocuments service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: DOCUMENT_FETCHED
events.description: migration.fetchDocument service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: COMMITTED
events.description: migration.commit service result — committed count plus per-unit failures

events.name: MIGRATION_CALL_FAILED
events.description: migration service call failure signal — lands the run in failed, never a silent swallow

events.name: MIGRATION_FETCHED
events.description: Source documents are listed and the run is ready for staging (deterministic pipeline or agent)
events.synonyms: import fetched, source listed, documents ready

events.name: MIGRATION_DOCUMENT
events.description: A single fetched document's content, for the host staging layer to map into target units

events.name: MIGRATION_REVIEW_READY
events.description: Staging is complete; the preview is ready for the approval gate. units/skipped/validationErrors forward the full staged rows when the host staged them, for a review-before-commit UI; stats-only hosts leave them empty.
events.synonyms: preview ready, staging complete, review import

events.name: MIGRATION_COMPLETED
events.description: The commit drained through the host sink; stats carry committed and per-unit failed counts
events.synonyms: import done, migration complete, data imported

events.name: MIGRATION_FAILED
events.description: The run failed; error carries the service-reported detail and the terminal job row was persisted

events.name: MIGRATION_START
events.description: Starts an import run. source is the ImportSource descriptor; files carries client file metadata for upload sources. Also reached via a sibling std-import's IMPORT_REQUESTED.
events.synonyms: start import, run migration, import data

events.name: FETCH_DOCUMENT
events.description: Fetch one document's full content from the source during staging

events.name: MIGRATION_STAGED
events.description: Host staging finished — units are staged and validated; stats summarize staged/skipped counts for the preview. units/skipped/validationErrors optionally carry the full staged rows (server ImportPreview shape) so reviewing can render an ImportPreviewTree instead of staying headless.

events.name: MIGRATION_DISCARDED
events.description: The run was discarded before commit

events.name: MIGRATION_APPROVED
events.description: The user approved the preview; units are the staged ImportUnits to commit through the host sink. Optional — the ImportPreviewTree's onConfirm fires with no payload, so commit falls back to the units already staged on the entity via MIGRATION_STAGED.

events.name: MIGRATION_REJECTED
events.description: The user sent the preview back for more staging

events.name: RESET
events.description: Returns the job to idle from a terminal state

events.name: MIGRATION_RETRY
events.description: Re-runs the fetch after a failure, with the same source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Connection reference
overridableConfigKeys.description: Secret-store / environment KEY holding the source credentials. The reference is stored; the secret itself never enters config, traces, or snapshots — the migration service resolves it at run time. (Typed `secret` — the config-field type that marks a credential reference; UI password-renders it and traces mask it.)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: credential key, connection string reference, secret name

overridableConfigKeys.label: Review slot
overridableConfigKeys.description: UI slot the staged-import review renders into when the host stages the full units/skipped rows (not stats-only). Defaults to the modal overlay so a host that never places this trait on a page — or that only ever sends {stats} — stays effectively headless; the rendered tree's confirm/cancel wire to the atom's own MIGRATION_APPROVED/MIGRATION_DISCARDED events.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: preview slot, review outlet, staging modal, import review slot

overridableConfigKeys.label: Target entity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into (e.g. the organism's own entity). The migration service derives the full target descriptor from the running app's schema.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: destination, import into, target type

overridableConfigKeys.label: Frequency cap (per week)

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: rate limit, cap, max per week, throttle, send limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard field (numeric)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field read from the upstream event's `data` payload and compared against `guardValue` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. 'stockLevel', 'quantity'). Ignored when `guardOp` is `eq`.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: threshold field, numeric field, compare field, watched field, data field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard comparison

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard value (numeric)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trigger events
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Channel
overridableConfigKeys.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. overridableConfigKeys.label: Push icon

overridableConfigKeys.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Jump Strength
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Kill Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Fall Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

overridableConfigKeys.label: Move Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

overridableConfigKeys.label: Platforms
overridableConfigKeys.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

overridableConfigKeys.label: Curve Skating
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Curve
overridableConfigKeys.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Snap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

overridableConfigKeys.label: Spawn Body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Left Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Decay Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Fx
overridableConfigKeys.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, PROGRESS signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze

events.name: PLAT_PLACE
events.description: Renamed PLACE consumed by the platformer-body authority; hazard/pit respawn teleport

events.name: PLAT_GOAL
events.description: Goal-tile contact signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_GOAL); scores and trips the win gate

events.name: PLAT_HAZARD
events.description: Hazard-tile contact signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_HAZARD); costs a life and respawns

events.name: PLAT_FELL
events.description: Pit-fall signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_FELL); costs a life and respawns

events.name: BURST
events.description: Floating-text particle batch spawned on score/damage; fx-particles fades it

events.name: PROGRESS
events.description: Sparse win/lose signal consumed by the objective-flow gate: objectivesLeft 0 = won, movesLeft 0 = lost

events.name: GAME_END
events.description: Win/lose resolution from the objective-flow gate; guarded by celebrated so it lands once

events.name: RESTART
events.description: Broadcast reset consumed by the platformer-body and objective-flow authorities on INIT/PLAY_AGAIN

events.name: PLAY_AGAIN

events.name: BODY_MOVED
events.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals

events.name: BODY_SKATE_START
events.description: Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts

events.name: BODY_SKATE_END
events.description: Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx

events.name: BODY_JUMPED
events.description: Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx

events.name: BODY_LANDED
events.description: Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage

events.name: BODY_HAZARD
events.description: Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse

events.name: BODY_GOAL
events.description: Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger

events.name: BODY_FELL
events.description: Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board

overridableConfigKeys.label: Gravity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Jump Strength
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Kill Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Fall Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

overridableConfigKeys.label: Move Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

overridableConfigKeys.label: Platforms
overridableConfigKeys.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

overridableConfigKeys.label: Curve Skating
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Curve
overridableConfigKeys.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Snap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

overridableConfigKeys.label: Spawn Body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Left Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Burst size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Requests allowed to burst above the per-minute rate before steady-state throttling kicks in. Lower burst = strict/no-spikes; higher burst = forgiving/allow-spikes.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: burst capacity, allowance, spike allowance, no-spike (low) vs allow-bursts (high)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enabled
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether rate limiting is active for the host orbital. Off by default; turn on to throttle requests.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, rate limit, throttle, requests per minute, slow down, cap usage, request cap, limit traffic, prevent abuse

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rate-limit key strategy

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: limiter key, bucket key

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: exempt roles, bypass list

overridableConfigKeys.label: Requests per minute
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute before throttling begins.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: rate limit, request cap, RPS, throttle threshold

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). enabled.description: Validate and apply status transitions against the configured table. Off by default.
enabled.x-synonyms: lifecycle, statuses, states, stages, workflow, status transitions, enforce, enable, apply

initialStatus.description: The status assigned when a record is first created.
initialStatus.x-label: What status do new records start in?

states.x-synonyms: states, stages, phases, statuses, lifecycle, workflow steps

statusField.x-synonyms: state field, stage field, status column, lifecycle field

targetEntity.description: Entity name whose status field this lifecycle drives (e.g. 'Contract'). Rebind per composition. Typed `entity`, so a rename of the bound entity threads through to this value automatically.

transitions.description: Legal transitions as { from, to, event, label }. Only matching moves are applied.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

name.description: Optional rename of the inlined trait.

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

name.description: Canonical page name from the orbital.

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background Image
overridableConfigKeys.description: Background image (tiled behind iso/hex/flat/free; cover-scaled for atlas slices). A bare URL string is accepted as shorthand for a standalone backdrop.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Camera Pos
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Children
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fit
overridableConfigKeys.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Follow Target
overridableConfigKeys.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Up Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Scale
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Hover Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Leave Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Editable
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, render an editable surface that composes a transparent `Textarea` over a Prism-highlighted overlay. The overlay re-tokenizes on each keystroke (driven from a local mirror of the textarea value), so users see syntax-highlighted code while still being able to type. Folding is skipped in editable mode. History: GAP-51 first-cut shipped plain (no-highlighting) editable text; GAP-77 (2026-04-12) added the Prism overlay layer. Default: false (existing read-only behavior unchanged).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Item Id Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Root
overridableConfigKeys.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drag Group
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drop Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Message shown when there are no rows. Falls back to the generic 'no items' translation. `TableView` already exposes this; an agenda or an inbox wants to say what 'empty' means in its own words.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fields
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field definitions for rendering each row. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group By
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group items by a field value (renders section headers between groups)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Has More
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

overridableConfigKeys.label: Item Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Load More Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

overridableConfigKeys.label: Long Press Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on long press: UI:{longPressEvent} with { row }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Inline Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max items to show before 'Show More' button. Defaults to 5. Set to 0 to disable.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reorder Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on reorder: UI:{reorderEvent} with { fromIndex, toIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sender Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field name identifying the sender (used with variant: 'message')

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sender Label Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field holding the sender's human-readable name (used with variant: 'message'). Defaults to `senderField`. Set this when `senderField` holds an id — an id-keyed thread otherwise labels bubbles `staff-1` instead of `Sam Staff`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort By
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field name to order rows by. Values are compared by their own type — numbers numerically, date-like strings chronologically, everything else alphabetically — never by what the field is called. Empty cells sort last. Unset leaves the incoming order untouched. Orders only the rows already fetched: a collection larger than its `limit` still needs ordering at the data layer.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sortable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

overridableConfigKeys.label: Swipe Left Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on left swipe: UI:{swipeLeftEvent} with { row }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Swipe Right Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on right swipe: UI:{swipeRightEvent} with { row }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Animation
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keyframe animation over the group TRANSFORM tracks (`offsetX/Y/Z` in cells, `rotateX/Y/Z` in radians, `scale`; the 2D painter also honors `opacity`) — children inherit it, so nested animated groups form a joint chain. Material tracks belong on leaf meshes.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bone
overridableConfigKeys.description: Skeleton bone name. A named group is addressable by a `draw-mesh` `skin` block (smooth skinning): the skinned mesh deforms with this group's animated transform. Names resolve within the nearest enclosing `skeleton: true` group (falling back to the canvas), so multiple instances of one rig never collide. Distinct from `id` (the hit-test handle).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Clip
overridableConfigKeys.description: Clip the group's items to an SVG path (`d` syntax) in world units relative to the group origin — masked reveals, meters, portraits.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Items
overridableConfigKeys.description: The grouped drawables, painted through the normal dispatch.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position
overridableConfigKeys.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rotation
overridableConfigKeys.description: Euler rotation `[x, y, z]` in radians (world axes) — per-axis joint rotation for the 3D backend; a group placed at a joint with children authored joint-local IS a bone. The 2D painter applies only the in-plane `z` component, after `rotate`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Scale
overridableConfigKeys.description: Uniform scale applied to the whole group.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skeleton
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks this group as a skeleton SCOPE: `bone` names and `skin` bindings in its subtree resolve against each other only — one scope per rig instance.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

animation.description: Keyframe animation over the group TRANSFORM tracks (`offsetX/Y/Z` in cells, `rotateX/Y/Z` in radians, `scale`; the 2D painter also honors `opacity`) — children inherit it, so nested animated groups form a joint chain. Material tracks belong on leaf meshes.

bone.description: Skeleton bone name. A named group is addressable by a `draw-mesh` `skin` block (smooth skinning): the skinned mesh deforms with this group's animated transform. Names resolve within the nearest enclosing `skeleton: true` group (falling back to the canvas), so multiple instances of one rig never collide. Distinct from `id` (the hit-test handle).

clip.description: Clip the group's items to an SVG path (`d` syntax) in world units relative to the group origin — masked reveals, meters, portraits.

items.description: The grouped drawables, painted through the normal dispatch.

position.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

rotation.description: Euler rotation `[x, y, z]` in radians (world axes) — per-axis joint rotation for the 3D backend; a group placed at a joint with children authored joint-local IS a bone. The 2D painter applies only the in-plane `z` component, after `rotate`.

scale.description: Uniform scale applied to the whole group.

skeleton.description: Marks this group as a skeleton SCOPE: `bone` names and `skin` bindings in its subtree resolve against each other only — one scope per rig instance.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Anchor
overridableConfigKeys.description: How the shape aligns to its projected position. Default varies by `shape`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Animation
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keyframe animation over this shape's props; the host runs a paint clock while present.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Blend Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: Composite/blend mode for this shape's draws (`lighter`, `multiply`, `screen`, …).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Blur
overridableConfigKeys.description: Gaussian blur in painter-px. Expensive — forces an intermediate raster; use sparingly.

overridableConfigKeys.label: D
overridableConfigKeys.description: SVG path data in world units relative to the cell's projected top-left — same coordinate convention as `points`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fill Pattern
overridableConfigKeys.description: Repeating texture painted over the fill (grain / tiling image).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Gradient
overridableConfigKeys.description: Gradient fill in world units; overrides `fill` when present.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rect height in world units (fractions of `projector.tileWidth`).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Offset X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fine nudge in world units — applies to every shape kind except `cell` (rect/ellipse from their anchor point; poly/path from the projected top-left).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Pivot
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rotation pivot in world units relative to the cell's projected top-left; default `{x:0.5, y:0.5}` (cell center).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Points
overridableConfigKeys.description: Poly vertices as world-unit offsets relative to the cell's projected top-left.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position
overridableConfigKeys.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Radius X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ellipse horizontal radius in world units (fractions of `projector.tileWidth`).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Radius Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ellipse vertical radius in world units; omitted → `radiusX` (a circle).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rotate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rotation in radians (painter units, same as `draw-group`), about `pivot`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Shadow
overridableConfigKeys.description: Soft glow / drop-shadow behind the shape; `blur` in world units.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stroke Dash
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dash pattern in painter-px (constant under group scale, like `strokeWidth`).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stroke Dash Offset
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dash phase offset in painter-px; animatable (marching ants).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stroke Gradient
overridableConfigKeys.description: Gradient stroke in world units; overrides `stroke` when present.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rect width in world units (fractions of `projector.tileWidth`).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Repulsion
overridableConfigKeys.description: Force-sim repulsion strength between nodes (larger ⇒ more spread out)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Similarity
overridableConfigKeys.description: All-pairs similarity (cosine 0–1) used ONLY for layout, never drawn. It is the secondary macro-layout: non-connected pairs get a weak spring (higher cosine ⇒ closer) so clusters arrange relative to each other; drawn `edges` stay the primary tight structure. When omitted, edges alone drive the layout.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rendering mode. - `'overlay'` (default): floating side panel positioned absolutely over the canvas. Density follows `disclosureLevel` (compact L1/L2, rich L3+). The `open` flag actually hides the panel when false. - `'tab'`: full-width content for a dedicated 'trace' supplemental tab. Always renders rich (regardless of disclosure level), always visible (the `open` flag is ignored), and includes an empty state when no subagents are present so users see the surface even before generation starts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Open
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the panel is visible. Typically auto-opens during generation in overlay mode.

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.
